## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Utilities, Energy). Confirmation: very low sector breadth and narrow leadership among top performers (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +10.97%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: VLO (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +28.34%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +33.76%) ABOVE TREND. Technology has pockets of strength (INTC, ORCL, AMD) but sector internals are mixed.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Healthcare lagging: AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak with BKNG (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -15.91%) BELOW TREND and broad softness. Technology shows dispersion — large-cap winners coexist with multiple losers.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +10.97%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -8.63% | 1M: -0.99%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -11.53%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -9.31% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION, NVS (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -11.92%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Healthcare names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (≥3 large caps with opposite 1W vs 1M: AAPL, V, MA, NOW) — watch for trend breaks; treat rallies as tactical until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is mixed with dispersion: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND versus MSFT (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth estimate: Tech: 9/24 positive. Expect rotation within Tech, not uniform leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are soft on the week: JPM (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.83% | 1M: +1.88%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.13% | 1M: +1.41%) CORRECTION — Sector breadth estimate: Financials: 7/20 positive. Financials are not confirming a broad rebound; monitor for stabilization before adding cyclicals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing weakness: AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: +2.94% | 1M: -1.53%) RECOVERY — Sector breadth estimate: Healthcare: 4/17 positive. Watch for headline-driven moves; sentiment is mixed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Utilities and Energy names showing clear 1W/1M strength (VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +28.34%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to deeply down Tech and Healthcare laggards (ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given narrow top-end concentration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +28.34%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -11.53%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Utilities (Breadth: Utilities positive) and Energy (Breadth: Energy positive). BEARISH: Healthcare (Sector breadth weak) and Consumer Discretionary — monitor for spillover into Tech.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch for follow-through above this week’s highs in INTC and ORCL to confirm TECH leadership pockets; ADBE and SHOP closing below this week’s lows would confirm expanding weakness; AMGN failing to regain weekly resistance would validate bearish sentiment.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (+55): Meta Muse AI launch; price confirming — META (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND. GOOGL (+55): €13bn AI data‑center investment; price diverging — GOOGL (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -4.44%) BELOW TREND. AMGN (+60): positive clinical data but price diverging — AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
SYK (-45): supply chain woes; price confirming weakness — SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND. ADBE (-35): earnings concern; price confirming — ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND. BA (-40): delivery weakness; news partially diverges from 1W uptick — BA (1W: +1.42% | 1M: -10.11%) RECOVERY.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (AAPL, V, MA, NOW) and news/price mismatches (AMGN bullish headlines but price DOWN) — watch for confirmation before adding risk.
